titles: Shift Berry Greek Yoghurt Protein Pot
method: Start with 0% Greek yoghurt in a bowl or lidded pot and stir it smooth.
Add the flavour ingredients in layers or fold them through depending on the texture you want; keep anything crunchy separate until the last minute.
Taste it before you pack it. If the fruit is sharp or the flavour needs lifting, use the measured sweet element rather than guessing.
Chill until needed and add the crunchy topping just before eating so it stays crunchy.
